about_the_game:
Game Description

Haetae: Guardians is a fantasy action-adventure game set in Joseon.

An anomaly befalls the Four Guardian Gods who once protected Joseon from monsters, and as monsters begin to appear, the nation falls into crisis.

At that moment, the protagonist is chosen by the Yellow Dragon and sets out on a journey with Haetae to purify the monsters.

As you investigate the cause of the calamity and the reason the Four Guardian Gods have changed, a story of purification unfolds, revealing hidden truths and a deeper narrative.

Game Features

Haetae: Guardians is an action game with intuitive and simple controls.

With a unique evasion system, you can experience tense and challenging combat.

All of Haetae’s skills possess purification abilities, and by accumulating enough damage on bosses and elite yokai, you can put them into a Stunned state.

Make active use of the Stunned state to deliver strategic and stylish attacks, and smash through hordes of yokai with satisfying combat.

Haetae and the Crown Prince each have their own unique progression systems, allowing for various builds, combinations, and growth paths.

short_description: This is a 3D top-down action-adventure game. Dodge enemy attacks by rolling and defeat your foes. Become the Crown Prince chosen by the Yellow Dragon, and save Joseon from chaos alongside Haetae. Challenge powerful bosses, learn their abilities, and experience an intertwined story and adventure.
